comparison.alignmentNote: Approximately one third of a second: opening-derived0.32s for most pairs;0.35s for140/175/225 to align rapid camera motion and the verified lens-cache cut. Every pair reports its exact requested timestamp. Native capture timing and canonical60Hz boundaries can differ by a frame.

audio.decodeNote: 512 PCM samples; best cross-correlation lag over +/-2048 samples; nonidentical amplitudes are expected from different resampling filters.
audio.limits: Uses browser-reported output timestamps. Actual speaker/headphone acoustic timing was not measured; reference-video audio was unavailable locally for waveform correlation.

limits: WebGL and Direct3D 7 rasterization, CPU/GPU clipping, interpolation, sampler behavior, precision and recording compression can differ; no whole-sequence pixel-identity claim.
Render-dependent springs and damping use a canonical 60 Hz cadence while the sequencer retains the native 1 ms tick; native runs at another refresh/render rate can differ.
Fixed startup RNG profile: zero clock-derived skip, two startup Tunnel resets, 32-bit textures without dithering. The reference startup heap/RNG state was not captured.

Comic row floats are uninitialized in the native constructor and Reset. The default recording profile preserves the frozen identity-rotation result seen in the reference; its exact original heap bits cannot be recovered. The zero-initialized comparison profile remains available.

Frame-begin lens, GPU fog enable/color and clear color are cached; live camera transforms and vertex-fog bounds are retained. Tests cover the 225339 ms cut, but do not execute a full native Direct3D rasterizer.
